name: Liu Zhiyuan

affiliations.role: Professor, Tsinghua University; ModelBest co-founder and Chief Scientist

bio: Zhiyuan Liu is a professor at Tsinghua University working on large language models, NLP and knowledge graphs, and co-founder and chief scientist of ModelBest, the company behind the MiniCPM models. Liu is one of the two principal investigators of the OpenBMB open-source community.
known_for: Co-founder and chief scientist of ModelBest
